newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amic announces 1.2 bln rand rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Amic announces 1.2 bln rand rights issue.

text.p: Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd said on Thursday it planned a 1.2 billion rand rights issue to help fund new projects.
The renounceable rights offer of new ordinary shares is open to shareholders registered on October 4. Details of the offer will be announced on September 30.

Amic said in a statement that the funds would be used both to assist in financing several major new projects and developments, and to supplement existing permanent resources to let the company take advantage of new opportunities as they arise.
"Once again this demonstrates the confidence of the Amic group in the South African economy," said chairman Leslie Boyd.
"Amic group companies are currently committed to capital expenditure -- both replacement and expansionary -- in excess of four billion rand."
- the recently announced acqusition by Mondi of the mining and timber interests of H.L.H. Timber Holdings valued at one billion rand;
- participation in AECI's global placement, announce on Wednesday;
- and Amic's acquisition last year of 20 percent of Hulett Aluminium, which is engaged in a 2.4 billion rand expansion of its rolled products facility.
